bio: Security-focused backend engineer and postgraduate student in Computer Networks and Information Security, with experience across Python APIs, security tooling, AI-powered products, and full-stack application development.

My work includes production-oriented healthcare integrations, threat intelligence automation, local AI interfaces, and credential detection systems. I care about building software that is secure, scalable, and maintainable — and about writing code that is readable and reliable.

projects.title: LeakLens
projects.description: A local-first credential vulnerability scanner for codebases and repositories. It flags exposed secrets while keeping analysis fully private to the developer's machine.
contributions: Built a layered detection pipeline combining regex pattern matching, entropy-based checks, and ML-assisted classification to catch exposed credentials.
Designed a local-first architecture so scanning happens entirely on the developer's machine, preserving privacy.
Implemented high-randomness (high-entropy) string flagging to surface secrets that signature-only rules miss.
Focused on false-positive reduction to keep results actionable in real development workflows.

projects.title: ChayaLM: Local AI Chat Interface
projects.description: A full-stack local AI chat application with a React + Vite frontend and FastAPI backend, delivering a private, configurable, cloud-like chat experience for Ollama-hosted models entirely on-device.
contributions: Implemented a UI framework that hooks directly into local AI runtimes (Ollama) for fully private inference.
Built a FastAPI backend with JWT auth, SQLite persistence, and streaming responses.
Delivered a cloud-like UX with conversation tracking and configurable model settings.
Built a minimal, product-grade interface focused on a privacy-driven architecture.

projects.title: CVScriptly-AI: AI-Powered ATS Resume Builder
projects.description: A privacy-first, browser-based AI resume builder with ATS-optimized templates, real-time preview, and multi-format export — generating polished, machine-parseable resumes in minutes.
contributions: Developed a responsive front end using Next.js and Tailwind CSS with real-time editing and preview.
Integrated AI-powered generation (Genkit) to auto-draft resume content and ensure strong ATS compatibility.
Implemented robust export to PDF and LaTeX, keeping all processing browser-side for privacy.
Established the deployment pipeline on Netlify for fast, highly-available hosting.

projects.title: Cognito: Automated Threat Intelligence Platform
projects.description: A Flask-based security tool that automates risk assessment for digital indicators, centralizing intelligence from multiple industry-standard APIs into a single consolidated security score — cutting triage time by 60% and speeding up development by 40%.
contributions: Engineered a Flask application integrating VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, and IPQualityScore APIs for automated risk scoring of URLs, IPs, hashes, and email headers.
Reduced manual analysis and triage time by 60%, improving classification efficiency and accuracy.
Used LLMs and prompt engineering to auto-generate analysis modules and threat reports, accelerating development by 40%.

projects.title: AIDFAS: AI-Driven Anomaly Detection & Digital Forensics
projects.description: A real-time cybersecurity platform combining machine learning, threat intelligence, and forensic data aggregation to support detection, investigation, and incident analysis, with phishing classification reaching 92%+ reported accuracy.
contributions: Implemented Isolation Forest for anomaly detection and TF-IDF + Logistic Regression for phishing classification, achieving 92%+ reported accuracy.
Built a live security alert dashboard and forensic investigation timeline using Flask and Bootstrap.
Integrated AbuseIPDB and AlienVault OTX for external threat intelligence enrichment.
Developed REST APIs aggregating forensic artifacts including logs, network data, memory dumps, and email evidence.
